summary: Chemomab Therapeutics Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC announcing that its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders has been adjourned from April 28, 2026 to May 5, 2026 due to a lack of quorum. The filing incorporates prior proxy statement furnished on March 20, 2026. This is a routine procedural adjournment to obtain quorum for an existing shareholder meeting. No special situation — such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or management change — is involved. The registrant's role is solely as filer of the report. No deal terms are present.
